human_check_steps:
# Check A03-world979

1. Type `houtokukai`, open the full list (↓ on the Mac, ⌄ on the phone): 彭 is there (about the 22nd); choose it.
2. `tokukai` is left: choose 徳 from the list (about the 18th). Then `kai` is left: choose 懐 (far down, it is in the list).
3. Next time, `houtokukai` offers 彭徳懐 as one candidate.
4. For the simplified Chinese 彭德怀, type `pengdehuai`: it comes first.
title: A name or word no dictionary has can be built one character at a time: houtokukai → 彭 (ほう), then 徳 (とく), then 懐 (かい)
